name: Molens in Nederland (Windmills and Watermills in the Netherlands)
title: Molens in Nederland (Windmills and Watermills in the Netherlands)
description: Comprehensive catalog of historic and contemporary windmills, watermills, and related mill structures (stellingmolens, grondzeilers, beltmolens, wipmolens, paltrokmolens, tjaskers, rosmolens) located in the Netherlands. Compiled via Wikipedia category traversal (Categorie:Molen in Nederland and Categorie:Windmolen in Nederland — including all sub-categories per Dutch municipality and province, plus 'Voormalige molen in Nederland' for historic and demolished mills) cross-referenced with Wikidata. Each record includes multilingual names (Dutch, English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian where available), mill type classification, administrative location (gemeente/municipality), coordinates, year built, year of dissolution where applicable, Commons image URL, Rijksmonument heritage ID, and Wikipedia sitelinks across 9 languages.
